subject.title: improve: index transcript mirror persistence checks

question: Should OpenClaw publish the three indexed writer-lock fact methods as supported plugin-SDK API, or keep this optimization behind a narrower internal/owner-specific seam?
rationale: The patch is intentionally adding persistent plugin-SDK surface rather than only optimizing private implementation; repository policy makes that contract and its compatibility commitment a maintainer choice.

options.title: Accept the SDK facts after parent lands
options.body: Keep the three typed facts public, document their lock and generation semantics, and rebase this child onto the merged parent before final merge review.

options.title: Narrow the boundary
options.body: Keep the performance optimization but move the facts behind an internal transcript accessor or a more specific owner-facing interface so the plugin SDK does not grow this contract.

recommendation.title: Accept the SDK facts after parent lands
recommendation.body: Keep the three typed facts public, document their lock and generation semantics, and rebase this child onto the merged parent before final merge review.

likelyOwner.reason: Adjacent Codex and plugin-SDK runtime history makes this the best available routing contact, though the ownership signal is incomplete.
